intro: Introducing a touch of elegance to your home with our cushion cover. It features white looped stripes on a solid black base. Perfect for modern urban homes, it blends style and comfort effortlessly.

features.title: Timeless style, never fades
features.text: Made from breathable cotton, it offers a soft, durable fabric that elevates your living space with lasting comfort.

features.title: Effortlessly chic, always your vibe
features.text: Its neutral tones and timeless design make it a versatile accessory, complementing a variety of home styles and color palettes.

features.title: Skill meets style quality shines through
features.text: Meticulously crafted with attention to detail, this cushion cover features strong stitching for a refined, high-quality finish.

care: Dry clean recommended or gentle hand wash with mild detergent and cold water. Wash separately to prevent color bleeding. Do not tumble dry. Do not bleach. Dry inside out in shade. Do not iron.
